name: Diboo core
description: Base functionality for a Diboo installation.

suggests.drupal/diboo_signature_pad: Basic drawing tool for image chain links
suggests.drupal/uploaded_file_filename_randomizer: Make image files not predictable in the filesystem

project_description: Diboo core provides the base functionality for a Diboo installation: a self-hostable, free-software implementation of the "telephone" / "Chinese whispers" game played with written phrases and drawings. A chain is started with a phrase; the next contributor sees only that phrase and draws it; the next sees only the drawing and describes it in words; the cycle repeats. When a chain reaches a configured number of links it is published and all its links become visible in chronological order. The module ships four node content types (Room, Chain, Phrase image chain-link types) with bundle classes and code-defined base fields, an admin settings form for default game rules (open-chain limits, links between contributions, links to publish, lock timeout), routes and access logic for starting chains and adding links, chain locking with automatic cron unlocking, and a public front page. It is intended as the base of a suite; the Diboo kickstart module can prepare a basic setup and a drawing tool such as Signature pad supplies the image widget.
